# Third-party assets

Asset Store packs live here, one folder per pack, **unmodified**. The folder contents are
git-ignored: every member imports the packs locally from *Package Manager → My Assets*.
Only the files the game actually uses are committed (see the root `README.md`).

After importing a pack, move its folder **inside the Unity Editor** (drag in the Project
window) to `Assets/ThirdParty/<Pack Name>/`, then run the URP material converter on it.

| Pack | Publisher | Used for | Status |

| Decrepit Dungeon LITE | Prodigious Creations | Undercroft walls, floors, pillars | Imported |
| Free Open Building | Dr.Bean | Marrow House interior layout | To import |
| Old Building | Rusik3Dmodels | Marrow House exterior shell | To import |
| Altar Ruins Free | Underhill Labz | Drowned Altar arena | To import |
